svg.title: aao_office floor plan
svg.text: aao_office · Ability Assessment Office, Mapo branch: Chae's assessment room
Plan in metres, north up. Ground floor of a plain five-storey civic block on a quiet side street off World Cup-ro, Seongsan-dong, Mapo-gu, about 6 minutes' walk
from Mapo-gu Office station (fictional, no real address). Room drawn to the Codex key world/keys/aao_office/ and scripts ch003, ch004. Also: aao_ext, aao_lobby.
INSET · aao_lobby (schematic, 1 m = 30 px), north up
1 Glass door, SE corner: long vertical bar handle, small
thumb-turn lock; opens into the room. Blank green exit plaque
2 Floor-to-ceiling glass partition onto the corridor (south). No
blind: Chae locks the door instead (ch4).
3 Three-seat navy waiting bench, SW alcove.
4 Tall filing shelves of binders, NW. In the ch4 blind test Taeo
5 Chae's pale-grey desk: two monitors on her RIGHT (west) half
facing her, keyboard, files, wrist-fob tray, desk phone.
6 Chae's rolling chair, north side: she faces the corridor glass
7 Small flat silver hand plate, visitor-right (east) end. No
analogue gauge: the reading is a dial graphic on her monitor.
8 Behind Chae: blank framed board; low cabinet with binders, a
plant and (from ch21) a small printer.
9 One broad east window, horizontal blinds: morning light lies
across the floor in hard shapes.
10 Two navy visitor armchairs facing north: Taeo in the EAST
one; Nib stands beside the WEST one (foam pad on its seat in
11 Blind test (ch4): T at the shelves, back to the room; N at
the west chair; Chae points from the desk.
a Four-wing revolving door (Nib goes round twice,
ch3) under a flat concrete canopy
b Plain glass push door beside it
c Goods door on the north-east side: Orrin's way
d Low pale-wood reception counter, blank number
e Ticket machine on a post
f Rows of linked blue-grey seats facing the
g Wall TV high on the right-hand (south) wall: KNN
h Leaflet rack + water dispenser; potted ficus by
i ID photo booth (Orrin doesn't fit, ch25; Sera
j Nib's spot, back to the north wall: he can see
the revolving door and the corridor opening (ch3)
K1 from the SE door toward the NW desk; K2 from
Chae's chair south to the glass (= ch3 P60 hook,
ch4 P01). ch4: from the corridor through the

far LEFT-centre and the window RIGHT. From
